newsitem.title: USA: Equitable Cos sees Q2 hit by $60 mln charge.
newsitem.headline: Equitable Cos sees Q2 hit by $60 mln charge.

text.p: Equitable Cos Inc said on Tuesday it expects a charge to be taken by Alliance Capital Management LP, of which it owns about 58 percent, will affect its second quarter earnings by about $60 million.

Alliance Capital said earlier on Tuesday it would take a non-recurring, non-cash charge of $121 million in the third quarter ending June 30 to reduce the recorded value of goodwill and contracts associated with its acquisition of Cursitor Holdings LP and Cursitor Holdings Ltd.
Equitable said the impact of the charge on its after-tax, consolidated net earnings to be reported for the second quarter is estimated to be about $60 million.
Equitable an insurance and investment management organisation.
